logp.method_description: Lipophilicity of the Pd(II) complex has been evaluated via “shake flask” procedure utilizing n-octanol/deionized water phase partition [30]. Proper amount of the Pd(II) complex (0.001 g/10 mL) was diluted in 10 mL blend of n-octanol and deionized water in equal volume (1:1 V/V) and shaken continuously for 24 h. After achieving the equilibrium condition, organic (n-octanol) and aqueous (deionized water) phases were carefully separated. Ultimately, the concentration of the metal complex in each separated phase was determined via electronic absorption spectroscopy and utilized to calculate log P (partition coefficient) using the equation log P = log ([Pd]in octanol/[Pd]in aqueous).
